cards.title: The One Ring
cards.subtitle: The Great Ring
cards.gameText: While wearing The One Ring, burdens may not be removed and each time bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead. Maneuver: Wear The One Ring until the regroup phase. Skirmish: If wearing the One Ring, add a burden to make bearer strength +3.

cards.title: Brought Down from Inside
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. At the start of each skirmish you may transfer this condition to a [ROHAN] Man. At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, return this condition to hand.
cards.lore: “Bring it down! Bring it down! Bring it down!”

cards.title: Pippin
cards.subtitle: Steadfast Friend
cards.gameText: Fellowship. Pippin is strength +1 for each tale you can spot (limit X, where X is the number of [SHIRE] companions you can spot).
cards.lore: “‘You must go - and therefore we must, too. Merry and I are coming with you.'”

cards.title: Úlairë Lemenya
cards.subtitle: Dark Enemy
cards.gameText: Fierce. Ulaire Lemenya is strength +1 for each [RINGWRAITH] possession in your discard pile (limit +9).
cards.lore: “‘Do you wish them to find you? They are terrible!'”

cards.title: Úlairë Nertëa
cards.subtitle: Dark Horseman
cards.gameText: Fierce. When you play Ulaire Nertea, name a race. The Free Peoples player must add a burden to assign Ulaire Nertea to skirmish a companion of the named race.
cards.lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.
